blocks.title: Log hot, score live, ride the band openings
blocks.body: Fictional mid-contest snapshot for a single-op station in a weekend HF contest. Rates change. Bands open and close. Keep the log honest and the rate board visible.

blocks.heading: Band activity board (now)
blocks.caption: Move the run when rate dies — do not marry a dead band.

blocks.heading: Recent log lines (example)
blocks.caption: Generic calls/exchanges for shape only — not a real contest submission.

blocks.heading: Operate checklist (keep the living page alive)

items.label: Update rate every 15 minutes
items.detail: If under goal, change band or mode strategy.

items.label: Protect unique multipliers
items.detail: A slow mult is still a mult — park a second VFO if you have one.

items.label: Log immediately; never trust memory in a pileup
items.detail: Busted calls cost more than a slow QSO.

items.title: Shift energy to 40
items.detail: Keep a run + S&P second radio if allowed.

items.title: 80 for mults
items.detail: Slow rate, high value — do not skip.

items.title: Clean dupes / chase holes
items.detail: Fill thin multipliers on the board.

blocks.title: Living artifact
blocks.body: In a real contest this page would refresh from the logger. Here the tables stand still as a grading-night snapshot of the same energy.

blocks.heading: CQ TEST
blocks.body: Set the next 15-minute rate goal on a sticky note. When it fails, change something audible — band, speed, or listening discipline.
